<span class=\"intro__hello\">שלום, שמי ס: Hello, my name is Sivan Navot, a physiotherapist (B.P.T., M.Sc.PT) specializing in pelvic floor rehabilitation, researcher and developer of the PFFM method, Pelvic Floor Fascial Mobilization.
רצפת האגן והבעיות הקשורות בה, עדיין אינה: In my view, the pelvic floor and the problems related to it still do not receive the attention they deserve.
מאז שנת 2000 <mark class=\"hl\">אני מטפל: Since 2000 <mark class="hl">I have been treating women and men, from childbearing age to after menopause,</mark> who suffer from problems related to pelvic floor dysfunction: urinary and fecal leakage, pelvic pain, pelvic organ prolapse, constipation, and difficulties around pregnancy and birth. Alongside my clinical work I do research, publish in scientific journals and lecture in Israel and abroad, to the general public and to professionals.
בעיות ברצפת האגן יכולות לפגוע מאוד באיכו: Pelvic floor problems can seriously affect the quality of life of those who suffer from them in many areas, such as social functioning, work, sexual function and self-image. Despite how common the condition is and how much it affects quality of life, <mark class="hl">there is still a taboo around the subject,</mark> and many of those affected do not seek medical advice or treatment because of the great embarrassment involved, or because they do not know about the options for diagnosis and treatment.
שרירי רצפת האגן קשורים קשר ישיר לתפקודנו: The pelvic floor muscles are directly linked to our sexual function - both to sexual arousal and during orgasm. Women or men with a dysfunction of, or pain in, these muscles may suffer from pain, discomfort,
היות ורצפת האגן משמשת בסיס תומך לאיברי ה: Since the pelvic floor serves as a supporting base for the pelvic and abdominal organs, these can, in some cases, descend through the openings in it. Prolapse usually occurs in women, and takes place through the vagina.
ההגדרה ``דליפת צואה`` מתייחסת לבריחה לא: The term "fecal leakage" refers to the involuntary loss of stool (whether hard or soft) or of gas. Of all the problems related to the pelvic floor, this is perhaps the most embarrassing
קיים מגוון שלם של הרגלי התרוקנות הנחשבים: There is a whole range of bowel habits that are considered normal. Although a large part of the population empties once a day, the norm ranges from 3 times a day to once every three days.
אי נקיטת שתן הינה בעיה רפואית מוכרת ונפו: Urinary incontinence is a well-known and common medical problem, affecting on average one in two older women. The problem does not belong only to the golden years, as quite a few people believe
במצב של שלפוחית רגיזה, שריר שלפוחית השתן: With an overactive bladder, the bladder muscle contracts involuntarily, even when the bladder fills with relatively small amounts of urine. In this condition the common complaints are urgency and frequent urination at night
